card.name: Final piece of ELIQUIS, SKYRIZI, uproar
card.fires_on: The last piece of a split word, mainly the ending of brand names ELIQUIS ("IS") and SKYRIZI ("IZ") inside drug labels. Also the "ar" ending of "uproar" in old narrative prose.

modes.label: Brand name endings
modes.description: The final piece of the brand names ELIQUIS and SKYRIZI when they appear in label text.
modes.example: the dose of ELIQU<<IS>> should be decreased by 50%

modes.label: Uproar
modes.description: The ending "ar" of the word uproar in historical narrative.
modes.example: amidst great upro<<ar>>, came to a resolution to urge upon
